result.summary: Adds functional test coverage for TorControl SAFECOOKIE authentication. It tests successful authentication as well as failure modes including failed AUTHCHALLENGE, invalid server nonce or hash, and invalid or missing cookie files.
result.problem: The node's TorControl SAFECOOKIE authentication implementation lacks automated functional test coverage, allowing potential regressions in Tor controller integration to go unnoticed.
evidence: PR description: "while working on #35292, i realised we did not have coverage for `SAFECOOKIE` authentication either, so i added it here"
result.scope_notes: Adds test coverage only; modifies one test file (+206 lines).
result.card: Adds functional test coverage for TorControl SAFECOOKIE authentication. Currently, this authentication mechanism has no automated test coverage against real or simulated Tor controllers, risking undetected regressions. Tests exercise successful authentication along with failure modes such as invalid server nonces, mismatched hashes, and missing cookie files.

risk.why: Touches only functional test files; a failure would manifest as CI test failure without impacting production node behaviour.
